name: FirstRand
evidence: FirstRand is the holding company of a portfolio of integrated financial services businesses comprising FNB (retail and commercial banking), RMB (corporate and investment banking) and WesBank (instalment credit and fleet management).

name: Liberty Group South Africa
evidence: Liberty Group Limited is a licensed life insurer, an authorised FSP (no.2409) and part of the Standard Bank Group, offering life insurance and investment solutions.

name: Momentum Group
evidence: Momentum Group Limited is one of South Africa's largest life insurers and integrated financial services companies, operating through brands Momentum, Metropolitan, Guardrisk and Eris.

name: Alexforbes
evidence: Alexforbes administration services cover the full spectrum of retirement fund structures including defined benefit, defined contribution, hybrid, stand-alone and umbrella funds.

name: Old Mutual Finance
evidence: Old Mutual loan offerings, including unsecured personal loans of up to R250 000, are made available through Old Mutual Finance (Pty) Ltd, a registered credit provider (NCRCP35).

name: Lesaka Technologies
evidence: Lesaka is a fintech company offering services to consumers, merchants and enterprises, including merchant acquiring, cash management, bill payments and card-acceptance technologies.

name: TransUnion
evidence: TransUnion is a registered credit bureau in South Africa and a repository of credit information on consumers and businesses.

name: Monocle Solutions
evidence: Monocle is an independent, results-focused management consulting firm specialising in banking and insurance, established in 2002.

name: Entersekt
evidence: Entersekt is a financial authentication company providing context-aware authentication, 3-D Secure and fraud-prevention risk intelligence to banks and payment networks.

name: Dimension Data
evidence: Dimension Data is an African-born systems integrator and managed services provider specialising in IT infrastructure solutions and services, and a member of the NTT Group.

name: Altron Digital Business
evidence: Altron Digital Business, launched on 1 March 2024 from the merger of Altron Karabina, Altron Systems Integration and Altron Managed Solutions, delivers enterprise-grade IT services including cloud infrastructure managed services, enterprise applications and digital infrastructure.

name: iOCO
evidence: iOCO is one of South Africa's largest and most established technology services providers, delivering IT infrastructure and managed services, ERP and EPM applications, cloud and cybersecurity to more than 4,000 clients.

name: Gijima
evidence: Gijima is described as one of South Africa's leading ICT companies in Cloud & Outsourcing, systems integration, cybersecurity and unified communications.

name: BBD
evidence: BBD is a global software engineering and custom (bespoke) software development partner that has built enterprise-grade systems for clients since 1984.

name: 4Sight Holdings
evidence: 4Sight Holdings is a JSE-listed multinational diversified technology group that designs, develops and deploys AI, big data, cloud, industrial IoT and digitised operational-technology solutions.

name: Truworths
evidence: Truworths International's main operating company Truworths Ltd is a leading South African retailer of fashion clothing and footwear that also offers account (credit) facilities to customers.

name: Kaap Agri
evidence: KAL Group, trading as Agrimark, supplies agricultural inputs and mechanisation, operates grain storage and marketing through Agrimark Grain and runs the fuel and retail network of a full-service agri group across southern Africa.

name: KWV
evidence: KWV is a leading South African wine and spirits producer whose portfolio includes wine brands such as Roodeberg and Laborie and spirits and brandy including KWV Brandy and Cruxland Gin.

name: Peninsula Beverages
evidence: Coca-Cola Peninsula Beverages is the independent bottling company that manufactures and distributes Coca-Cola products throughout the Western and Northern Cape.

name: Coca-Cola Beverages South Africa (CCBSA)
evidence: Coca-Cola Beverages South Africa is an authorised manufacturer and distributor of Coca-Cola products, producing sparkling soft drinks such as Coca-Cola, Sprite and Fanta at 11 manufacturing plants.

name: The Coca-Cola Company
evidence: The Coca-Cola Company creates the concentrates and syrups for its beverage brands and licenses independent bottling partners to produce the finished soft drinks and other beverages.

name: Libstar
evidence: Libstar Holdings is a diversified South African food group that manufactures and distributes branded, private-label and dealer-own food products across perishable and ambient categories.

name: Capespan South Africa
evidence: Capespan is an integrated fruit grower, packer and global distributor and marketer that exports fresh citrus, table grapes and pome fruit from South Africa to markets worldwide.

name: Netcare
evidence: Netcare describes itself as the leading private healthcare provider in South Africa, operating acute, mental health and day hospitals across the country.

name: Advtech
evidence: ADvTECH is Africa's largest private education provider, running private schools such as Crawford International and registered private higher education brands through the Independent Institute of Education.

name: Ardagh Glass Packaging SA
evidence: Ardagh Glass Packaging - Africa, established when Ardagh acquired Consol Glass, manufactures glass packaging for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries in South Africa.

name: Macsteel
evidence: Macsteel describes itself as a Southern African leader in steel and value-added steel products, manufacturing tube and pipe and processing coil and flat steel as well as merchandising and distributing steel.

name: EnviroServ
evidence: EnviroServ is South Africa's largest waste management company, collecting, treating and disposing of general and hazardous waste and recycling around 125,000 tonnes a year.

name: Westcon-Comstor Sub-Saharan Africa
evidence: Westcon-Comstor Sub-Saharan Africa is a value-added distributor that connects leading IT vendors of networking, security and cloud solutions with resellers across the region.

name: Parexel
evidence: Parexel is among the world's largest clinical research organizations, providing Phase I to IV clinical development services to biopharmaceutical companies.

name: Eskom Holdings SOC
evidence: Eskom Holdings SOC Ltd is a South African state-owned electricity public utility that generates, transmits and distributes electricity.

name: Anglo American
evidence: Anglo American describes itself as a leading global mining company whose portfolio spans copper, premium iron ore, diamonds (De Beers), platinum group metals and steelmaking coal.

name: African Rainbow Minerals
evidence: ARM states it is a diversified mining and minerals company that mines and beneficiates iron ore, manganese ore, chrome ore, PGMs, nickel and coal in South Africa.

name: Tronox Namakwa Sands
evidence: Tronox's Namakwa Sands operations on the West Coast of South Africa mine and beneficiate heavy minerals to produce titanium dioxide feedstock, zircon, rutile and pig iron.

name: AECI
evidence: AECI is a South African mining and chemicals group that manufactures explosives, initiating systems, blasting services, mining chemicals and specialty chemicals.

name: Raubex Group
evidence: Raubex's Roadmac Surfacing Cape is a leading road rehabilitation contractor specialising in asphalt, chip and spray surfacing and road rehabilitation.

name: Takealot
evidence: Takealot.com is South Africa's largest online retailer and its Marketplace enables thousands of third-party sellers to offer goods to consumers.

name: African Development Bank
evidence: The African Development Bank Group is Africa's premier multilateral development finance institution, providing loans, guarantees and equity financing to its regional member countries.

name: Sand Technologies
evidence: Sand Technologies builds Symmetri, an AI platform for critical infrastructure, and describes itself as delivering enterprise AI, data science and software engineering services.

name: Lula
evidence: Lula, formerly Lulalend, provides uncollateralised digital working-capital loans of up to R5 million to South African SMEs and a digital business banking platform.

name: Mint Group
evidence: Mint Group is a Microsoft Solutions Partner and systems integrator delivering Microsoft Dynamics 365 business applications, Azure and Microsoft 365 solutions.

name: ICON
evidence: The name ICON is ambiguous across firms; interpreted here as Cape Town-headquartered Icon Oncology, a private healthcare company providing radiotherapy, chemotherapy and managed oncology care.

name: South African Reserve Bank
evidence: The SARB's mandate is to protect the value of the currency and enhance financial stability, and it regulates and supervises financial institutions and the national payments system.

name: City of Cape Town
evidence: The City of Cape Town is a metropolitan municipality that distributes electricity and provides water, sanitation, refuse removal and municipal roads within its jurisdiction.
